soldier: Head reddish brown, mandibles blackish brown, labrum yellowish brown, pronotum yellowish brown with darker margins, legs pale yellowish brown, tibiae and tarsi darker. The median area of the pronotum bears about 20 long hairs. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle pore distinct but projecting scarcely above the surface. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 strongly sclerotised and longer than segment 2; the flange over the antennal socket is equally strongly sclerotised and remains far from the lateral margins of the head. Compound eyes pale yellow, their distance from the antennal socket about equal to the short diameter of the eye. Labrum subcircular, the labral apex slightly flattened. Mandibles short, the apices directed straight forward, the length of the left mandible about equal to the greatest width of the head and 0.55–0.61 times the length of the head capsule. Anterior margin of the pronotum shallowly concave in a broad V, the lateral margins sloping steeply backwards, the posterior margin hardly concave at the centre, the median longitudinal line visible.
